scope: Current issuer status for authenticated grant-chain subjects
invariant: A checked status batch identifies exactly the requested actors under the pinned issuer and reports only committed identity state.
required_evidence: Both authorized hosts in Debug and ASan/UBSan
Full P00-P10 baseline with unchanged acceptance lock
Real enrollment, credential revocation, actor revocation, and restart
Independent checked-client counterexamples for identity, order, count, and flags
Database witnesses for read-only behavior and rolled-back revocation
Counterexamples detect ignored actor revocation and an ignored issuer pin
limitations: Actor status is not proof of key possession or resource authority.
A status reply does not make later effects atomic with identity state.
Live world and workspace grant-store integration remains required.
Nonempty bootstrap profiles and distributed cancellation remain required.
